text_simplified: Drugs pose a great danger to minds and bodies, leading to the deviation of young men and women. One of the most important foundations of *tarbiyah* (upbringing) is for the parent to be a good example (*uswah hasanah*) for their children, commanding them toward good and forbidding them from evil. The parent’s words must align with their actions; otherwise, contradiction and confusion arise in the children. The benefit of a parent’s advice and guidance comes from acting upon it, not merely hearing the words without application.
